title: problem.modeled (v1)
description: ProblemModelingAgent's ModelingProblem mode (state machine V1.10 §1) has read the frozen ResearchSpec, LiteratureBrief, and NoveltyAuditReport and frozen a ProblemModel into the Research Store (see agents/problem_modeling_agent/data-contracts/problem_model.schema.yaml) and signals ResearchOrchestrator to transition ModelingProblem -> HumanIdeaCheckpoint. Payload is intentionally minimal: the artifact is read from the Research Store by ref.

problem_model_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ProblemModel object.
